Final copies of the second press of the Deluxe Edition Transparent Red Vinyl are in stock and shipping now. After thirteen years of silence from the compound, during which anticipation has grown day by day, Boards of Canada finally returned in 2026 with their 5th album, Inferno. Retaining their signature melodies and atmospheres, it draws on the esoteric influences explored in Societas X Tape (their 2019 NTS mix for Warp Records’ 30th anniversary) and the darker ambience introduced on Tomorrow’s Harvest, further deepened by an expanded role for speech soundbites.
